def createparser():
    \"\"\"Create an argparse.ArgumentParser for pysemver.\"\"\"
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='pysemver',
        description='Semantic Versioning command-line interface')
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command')

    # bump command
    bump_parser = subparsers.add_parser('bump', help='Bump version component')
    bump_parser.add_argument('version', help='Version string')
    bump_parser.add_argument('component', choices=['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'],

    # replace command
    replace_parser = subparsers.add_parser('replace', help='Replace version component')
    replace_parser.add_argument('version', help='Version string')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--major', type=int, help='Major version')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--minor', type=int, help='Minor version')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--patch', type=int, help='Patch version')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--prerelease', help='Prerelease tag')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--build', help='Build metadata')

    # compare command
    compare_parser = subparsers.add_parser('compare', help='Compare two versions')
    compare_parser.add_argument('v1', help='First version')
    compare_parser.add_argument('v2', help='Second version')

    # parse command
    parse_parser = subparsers.add_parser('parse', help='Parse version string')
    parse_parser.add_argument('version', help='Version string')

    return parser


def process(args):
    \"\"\"Process command line arguments.\"\"\"
    parser = createparser()
    args = parser.parse_args(args)

    if args.command == 'bump':
        vi = parse_version_info(args.version)
        method = getattr(vi, 'bump_' + args.component)
        result = method()
        print(result)
    elif args.command == 'replace':
        kwargs = {}
        for key in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
            if hasattr(args, key) and getattr(args, key) is not None:
                kwargs[key] = getattr(args, key)
        result = replace(args.version, **kwargs)
        print(result)
    elif args.command == 'compare':
        v1 = parse_version_info(args.v1)
        v2 = parse_version_info(args.v2)
        print(compare(v1, v2))
    elif args.command == 'parse':
